data.one_liner: Input formatters for international phone numbers, credit/debit cards, currencies, and custom masks.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of Flutter text input formatters and utility methods to automatically format phone numbers, credit/debit cards, and currency values. It also includes validation helpers for phone numbers, Bitcoin wallets, and a widget to easily unfocus text fields.
use_when: You need to format and validate phone numbers with country code detection.
You need to format credit or debit card input fields with card type detection.
You need to display and format currency values as users type.
avoid_when: You require complex state management solutions for your forms.
You are looking for a complete UI component library or form builder.
strengths: Automated detection of phone numbers and credit card systems.
Includes helpful string extensions for currency and number formatting.
Provides a simple Unfocuser widget to dismiss keyboards.
weaknesses: Card validation can return true only for supported card systems.
Relies on a predefined list of card systems and phone codes.
data.setup_notes: No complex native setup required. Simply import the package and add the desired formatters to your TextFormField inputFormatters list.
